name: app-core-banking-screens-flow-board-with-serif-italic-headline
title: Board of core banking screens on pearl-slate gradients: home, transactions, send money, confirm, add money, pay bills and payment success
whatItIs: An off-white board with a pill 'Core Banking', a headline 'One Dashboard, Every Financial Move.' with bold italic serif, a right paragraph, four pill tabs and phones arranged in rows: a home, then transactions, send money and a confirm sheet, then add money and a keypad amount, then pay bills, provider list, payment confirmation and Bill Paid success.
whatItMeans: Orderly and calm; a consistent gradient and sheets show a whole payment flow.
techniques: Fade each screen from white to slate.
Set a headline with italic serif emphasis.

vocabulary.definition: Rows of screens grouped by task.
A bottom sheet showing transfer details.
A slider control confirming an action.
A state confirming a completed payment.
